Today, our little ones had some very special guests at our preschool! 

The joy on their faces as they gently petted & interacted with them was priceless. It was a beautiful opportunity for our children to learn about kindness, gentleness & compassion towards all living beings.

We learn, so our children can thrive. 💛

Today, our teachers attended an insightful training session on Understanding Children’s Behaviour — exploring what lies behind their actions, emotions, reactions, and individual needs.

At Little Odyssey, we believe that being a great teacher is not just about teaching children; it’s about continuously learning, observing, understanding, and growing alongside them.

Because every behaviour has a story, and every child deserves to be understood. 🌱
